proof_attempt_summary: Discovery established matching unrestricted full-record shortfall risk of order 2^d/(b d^2) after ceil(B^d), for every fixed public B>2, with an explicit base-dependent lower constant, legal supported priors, a realized-target variance charge and a total attaining estimator. Mathematical review passed and independent terminal validity confirmed, but the final incremental novelty assessment (6.4 below the field gate 7.4) ended the run; three decision-review positioning/ballast findings remain disclosed above. The exact B=2 onset and critical transition remain unresolved and require new mathematics; no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: For each public base \(\mathsf B>2\), the fixed-cutoff finite-population shortfall contrast under independent half-Bernoulli affine interference has unrestricted complete-record minimax squared risk between \(c(\mathsf B)2^d/(bd^2)\) and \(128\,2^d/(bd^2)\) for all finite positive \(d\) and \(b\ge\lceil\mathsf B^d\rceil\). The positive lower constant is explicitly evaluable. A total observable residualized score attains the upper rate. A parameterized atom-inclusive coefficient lift cancels every non-treated assignment projection; its positive envelope and full numerical-record information calculation certify the lower bound while charging realized-target variation. Each fixed bounded degree range admits the same order for every positive sample size, with a range-dependent constant.
gap: The inherited shortfall score order does not exclude biased or nonlinear functions of exact numerical interiors. Generic empirical-functional testing leaves the legal destination channel unevaluated, while outcome zeroing generally exits the affine class.
fill: A lawful endpoint-only signed projection perturbation, completed into supported probabilities with an evaluated radius, yields a finite onset and universal lower constant. Its combination with inherited observable residualization gives the matched eventual order and a one-source calibration.
